sections.title: Everything you need under one roof

items.title: New & Used Inventory
items.body: A constantly updated selection of trucks and equipment, ready to work.

items.title: Expert Service
items.body: Factory-trained technicians and a fully equipped shop keep you moving.

items.title: Genuine Parts
items.body: OEM and aftermarket parts in stock, with fast shipping nationwide.

sections.title: Decades of keeping fleets on the road
sections.body: We've spent decades earning the trust of owner-operators and fleet managers alike. From the first handshake to long-term service, our team treats your business like our own.

items.quote: Best dealer experience I've had in 20 years of trucking. Straight answers and fast service.
items.author: Marcus T.

items.quote: Their parts team always has what we need in stock. Keeps our fleet running.
items.author: Dana R.

items.question: Do you offer financing?
items.answer: Yes. We work with multiple lenders to find competitive rates for new and used purchases. Apply online or talk to our finance team.

items.question: Can I schedule service online?
items.answer: Absolutely. Use our contact form or call any location to book a service appointment that fits your schedule.

items.question: Do you ship parts?
items.answer: We ship genuine OEM and aftermarket parts nationwide, usually the same business day for in-stock items.
